deadline.value: The acceptance page gives no application deadline.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention the Mathematics GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Acceptance requires a written doctoral agreement with the supervisor and a synopsis of about 1-2 pages.
supervisor.quote: Doctoral agreement in writing between the doctoral candidate and the supervisor with a detailed synopsis of about 1-2 pages

funding.value: Doctoral candidates are funded through varied external and institute sources, with no tuition charged.
funding.quote: When pursuing a doctorate at KIT, no tuition fees will be charged. In case of an ▶ enrollment as a doctoral student, you will have to pay semester charges only. Various options exist to cover your living expenses during the doctoral phase. Funding of the doctorate from different sources is common practice.

entry_route.value: Graduates of undergraduate programs can also apply, but must prove their scientific qualification in addition to the usual documents.
entry_route.quote: Graduates of undergraduate programs or graduates of universities of applied sciences and cooperative state universities additionally have to submit a proof of their scientific qualification

notes: Acceptance is decided by the Doctoral Admissions Committee under the 2016 regulations cited on the page. Graduates of foreign universities and of other subjects must first get their degree recognised.
